verdict.rationale: Browserbase is built to be driven without a UI. Its official SDK controls headless browsers running on its cloud, sessions can be created and controlled programmatically, a terminal-based Browse CLI exists, and agents can run on a schedule or on demand. A community comment also describes it as a serverless headless browser product. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote:
the official `@browserbasehq/sdk` package is the easiest way
to connect to and control headless browsers running on Browserbase.
Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.
Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Use the Browse CLI when you want your agent to stay in the terminal
